newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Digitel says 9-mth net at 415.4 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Digitel says 9-mth net at 415.4 mln pesos.

text.p: Digital Telecommunications Philippines Inc (Digitel), the telecommunications arm of JG Summit Holdings, said on Tuesday it posted a net income of 415.4 million pesos for the first nine months of 1996.
It did not disclose comparative figures for the same period last year.
But William Pamintuan, Digitel senior vice-president said for the full year 1995, the company's profits reached 170.9 million pesos.
The company said that third quarter profits for this year was 208.5 million pesos.
Digitel said its higher profits could be attributed to the growing toll traffic and higher subscriber base.

The company added that the traditional high volume of calls during the Christmas season along with its recently concluded initial public offering (IPO) will improve Digitel's income during the last quarter of 1996.
